text:
Maya: quick flag  ZephyrX-int8 canary (funcall suite) shows spike in parse rejects when routed through fallback chain.
Jon: spike numbers?
Maya: baseline float32 parse fails ~0.7% -> zephyrx-int8 routed path ~5.9% on same prompt set.
Akiko: did we change the prompt prefix or the tool instruction formatting for mirrors?
Maya: yes, routing adds a tiny diagnostic prefix when we mirror to liteq; suspect subtle token boundary shifts.
Sam: can you paste raw failure samples?
Maya: pasted two sanitized examples from the run log:
```
# example A (expected object)
{"action":"invoke","tool":"lookup","args":{"query":"foo"}}
# model returned
{"action":"invoke","tool":"lookup","args":["query:foo"]}  // array-wrapped payload

# example B (expected metadata object)
{"result":"ok","metadata":{"id":"123","score":0.9}}
# model returned
{"result":"ok","metadata":null} // null instead of object
```
Lina: our int8 config used per-channel asymmetric quant + kv-cache-compression toggle ON. That combo can shift token alignments in some cases.
Jon: interestingly the failures are concentrated on requests that went through the multi-route fallback (mirror -> liteq). If we forced single-route (mirror only) failure rate drops a lot.
Akiko: two possible fixes: 1) sanitizer that normalizes a few common shape errors (array->object, null->{ }), 2) reranking candidate prefixes so the model stays aligned to the expected shape.
Sam: we already have a small repair layer for legacy models. We can port it as a lightweight pre-parse normalizer that only runs for experimental canaries.
Maya: I'd rather not change the gating semantics permanently. For now, whitelist repair heuristics only on the onboard job and do semantic checks after repair.
Jon: agree. Add a semantic correctness eval (run the repaired outputs through the golden checker) so we don't accept repaired-but-wrong payloads.
Akiko: I'll prototype a tiny sanitizer: `tools/parse_repair.py` (python) that attempts these transforms: single-element array -> object with inferred field, null -> {}, dangling trailing commas cleanup, and JSON-string-in-LF repair. Add unit tests.
Lina: i'll kick off routing-variant canary matrix (mirror-only, mirror+liteq, liteq-only) with the current int8 artifacts and attach diffs. Command: `./dev/run_canary.sh --model zephyrx-int8 --suite funcall_struct --variants mirror,mirror+liteq,liteq --limit 400`
Sam: also try bumping `max_new_tokens`+`stop_token` heuristics to see if truncation is producing the array wrapper.
Maya: canary artifacts uploaded: https://canaries.internal/6265123456/zephyrx-int8/ (report & logs).
canary-bot: Canary finished (6265123489)  summary: https://canaries.internal/6265123456/summary.csv
dev-ops-bot: Allocations note: liteq pool has been using newer kernel selection (experimental) since 2026-02-10.
Jon: action items:
- Lina/Sam: run the variant matrix and attach per-route parse-fail CSVs by EOD PT.
- Akiko: open a draft PR with `parse_repair.py` + tests; include a flag to opt-in for canaries only.
- Maya: coordinate semantic acceptability tests (golden checker) and the gating rule change (temporary relax).
- Jon: if combined sanitizer + rerank reduces parse rejects to <1.5% and semantic regression <0.4% vs float32 baseline, mark int8 onboard as "limited dedicate"; otherwise revert to float32 for now.
Akiko: starting prototype now, will ping for code review in this thread. :sparkles:
Lina: logs & raw samples attached: https://logs.redwood/6265123456/zephyrx-int8.log
Maya: thanks all, we'll reconvene after the matrix run.
